intro.text: One of the relatives Tress claims to have lost on the Oot's Dream, most likely invented for the occasion.

items.text: Marple was one of three names, with Kaplan and Mallory, that Tress gave Crow as family killed on the Oot's Dream. The lie gave Crow a reason to let her go ashore at Shimmerbay and spread the tale of the deadrunners, but Tress stayed aboard.
